side.notes: Exact live-fish pages and FishBase proportions show the deep armored shoulder, steep taper into the peduncle, sloping head roof, short snout, flatter belly and fin placement.

top.uncertainty: Moderate to high. The osteology supplies a dorsal skull outline and FishBase notes a predorsal color patch, but no verified live whole-body orthographic top photograph was found.
top.notes: The revised half-width stations use the pyriform head-roof evidence and frontal cheek width qualitatively. They are not claimed as calibrated soft-tissue measurements.

front.notes: The exact frontal head page clearly shows embedded lateral eyes, broad armored cheeks, a flattened underside, a small transverse inferior mouth and two sizes of tapered barbels. Full-trunk frontal depth remains outside the photograph's scope.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: deep armored shoulder with a sloping head roof
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Maximum depth remains within FishBase's observed range at the pectoral-girdle shoulder, while the posterior tapers earlier and successive operculum, head and snout stations descend continuously. This breaks the rejected candidate's uniformly inflated capsule shape.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: flattened belly, short rounded snout and inferior mouth
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: A flatter ventral exponent and nearly aligned ventral ridges support the resting body plan. A broader blunt snout plus clearly separated shallow upper and lower lip arcs place a small transverse mouth beneath the head without a circular terminal ring.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: embedded eyes and tapered maxillary and lower barbels
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Smaller, more deeply seated eyes follow the lateral head contour. Four tapered tube adornments now root directly beside and beneath the inferior mouth, following the exact frontal barbel image.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: narrow peduncle, forked caudal and strong leading fin spines
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: The posterior trunk narrows earlier into a distinct peduncle. Reduced caudal, dorsal and paired-fin spans preserve the tall triangular dorsal and leading pectoral spine without turning them into oversized planar sails.

proportions.name: maximum adult standard length
proportions.notes: FishBase reports 7.5 cm standard length. The source records that exact scope and does not silently convert it to total length.

proportions.name: maximum body depth divided by station-defined standard length
proportions.notes: FishBase's body-height range is 1/2.9 to 1/2.5 of standard length, or about 0.345 to 0.400. The revised source is approximately 0.345 at the deepest shoulder over the unchanged 62 mm station-defined standard length.

proportions.name: maximum body width relative to maximum body depth
proportions.uncertainty: Moderate to high. The frontal photograph covers the head, and the osteology covers the skull, but neither calibrates live whole-trunk soft-tissue width.
proportions.notes: The broad armored head and operculum remain wider than the trunk while the peduncle tapers sharply. A future verified dorsal photograph can supersede this conservative live-width estimate.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: dark olive-bronze lateral field over a pale belly
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: A bounded trunk mask now separates the olive-bronze lateral field from the pale ventral surface instead of producing a nearly uniform beige body.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: two staggered rows of lateral armor plates
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Two independently centered and staggered procedural rows replace generic whole-body scale relief. The plates remain normal relief rather than separate scute meshes.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: translucent yellow-amber fins with stronger leading spines
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Fin alpha and amber color remain light while dorsal and pectoral leading edges receive darker relief cues.

reviewedCandidate.notes: The user rejected the runtime result as subpar. The candidate remains too capsule-like, its head and fins lack a convincing Cory read, and the inferior mouth and barbels are not legible enough at game scale.

mismatches.note: The body still reads as a smooth inflated capsule with an indistinct head. Future fable-v5 preserves observed adult depth at the shoulder but narrows the posterior earlier, steepens the head-roof descent and retains a broader blunt snout.

The frontal read does not clearly communicate the exact reference's small inferior transverse mouth and two barbel lengths. Future fable-v5 separates the shallow lip arcs, seats them against the ventral snout, and reroots longer tapered barbels around the mouth corners.

The dorsal, caudal and paired fins overpower the catfish body and contribute to a generic fish silhouette. Future fable-v5 reduces those spans while retaining the dorsal and pectoral leading-spine cues and existing animation clips.
The olive-bronze flank, pale belly, staggered armor rows and translucent amber fin paint remain valid and are reused unchanged for future fable-v5.

inferior transverse mouth and both barbel lengths remain visible in front and oblique views
reduced fins preserve a tall triangular dorsal, adipose fin and forked caudal without body intersections

failedCandidateEvidence.review: The user rejected the candidate as subpar. The source-backed olive-bronze color and armor treatment remain useful, but the capsule silhouette, oversized fins and weak inferior-mouth read are superseded by the fable-v5 source.

uncertainty: No verified live whole-body orthographic top photograph was found. Trunk width is inferred conservatively from the frontal head image, dorsal skull anatomy and observed lateral depth.
pixelPolicy: No source pixels were copied, sampled, traced, hotlinked or redistributed.
